project_type: Android app (Kotlin 2.0.20, Jetpack Compose, Hilt DI, Room, Retrofit, kotlinx-serialization)
build_system: Gradle with version catalog (libs.versions.toml). CANNOT run Gradle in sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network). AST/source-level validation only.
test_framework: JUnit4 with real instances and fake interfaces (NO MockK). Tests in app/src/test/java/com/foxtrader/app/. Pattern: create a FakeXxxApi implementing the Retrofit interface, inject into the DataSource class, assert computed values.
build_command: Cannot run (no Gradle in sandbox). CI verifies after push.
test_command: Cannot run (no Gradle in sandbox). CI verifies after push.
verification_instructions: Source-level validation: (1) verify all imports resolve to existing files/packages, (2) confirm class signatures follow existing patterns, (3) confirm no android.* in unit tests, (4) no MockK usage, (5) no TODOs/stubs.
setup_instructions: No setup possible - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY mode, no dependency download. Work at source level only.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no Gradle/dependency download, no Docker. Source-level changes only; CI verifies after push.
contribution_requirements: NO MockK in tests. NO android.* imports in unit tests. NO TODOs/placeholders/stubs. Match existing patterns exactly (DI, naming, file locations). Tests must assert real computed values.

key_patterns.di: Hilt @Module @InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class). NetworkModule provides Retrofit instances with qualifiers (e.g. @BinanceRetrofit). RepositoryModule uses @Binds for interface->impl. Each domain gets its own module file in di/.
key_patterns.api: Retrofit interfaces in data/remote/api/ (e.g. BinanceApi.kt). DataSource classes wrap API calls, map DTOs to domain models (e.g. BinanceDataSource.kt).
key_patterns.websocket: OkHttp WebSocket in data/remote/websocket/. Pattern: @Singleton class, @PublicMarketDataClient OkHttpClient, MutableStateFlow<ConnectionState>, MutableSharedFlow<TickUpdate>.
key_patterns.viewmodel: @HiltViewModel class with @Inject constructor. MutableStateFlow<UiState>. Delegating to controllers (ChartDataController, ChartAiCoordinator, etc.).
key_patterns.chart_layers: DrawScope extension functions in feature/chart/presentation/components/layers/. Take viewport: ChartViewport, cw: Float, ch: Float. Viewport-culled drawing.
key_patterns.tests: JUnit4 with real instances or fake interfaces (NOT MockK). FakeXxxApi pattern: inner class implementing the Retrofit interface, returning canned responses.
key_patterns.data_provider_enum: DataProvider enum in domain/model/DataProvider.kt with displayName, supportsLive, requiresApiKey, apiKeyLabel, implemented fields.
key_patterns.indicator_toggles: IndicatorToggles data class in ChartUiState.kt. Each toggle is a Boolean field. IndicatorPanel.kt renders Chip() for each.
key_patterns.chart_screen: ChartScreen.kt uses activeMenu state to show/hide panels. CandleChart is the canvas composable. Layers drawn in order inside Canvas drawScope.

directory_structure: app/src/main/java/com/foxtrader/app/ with: data/ (remote/api, remote/websocket, remote/dto, local/dao, local/entity, mapper, repository), di/, domain/ (model, repository, sdk, usecase/*), feature/ (auth, chart, litx, settings, ...), ui/ (navigation, theme). Tests at app/src/test/java/com/foxtrader/app/.
